title: Tell the owner about each new order
summary: When your online shop sends a new order, tell the owner the order number, customer and total.
description: Gives your online shop or order form a signed web address. Each order it sends (order number, customer name and total in naira) is sent to the owner straight away, and an order sent twice is only sent once. The owner hears on the WhatsApp or Telegram they linked to Taskiem, or by email.

params.name: path
params.title: Web address path
params.description: The path your shop calls, e.g. /orders/new.

definition.name: Text the owner about each new order

steps.name: Tell the owner about the order

input.message: ='New order ' + trigger.body.order_id + ' from ' + trigger.body.customer_name + ': NGN ' + string(trigger.body.total_naira)
